title: Frustrating Lid Closing & Pour Spout Design
text:
Frustrating Lid Closing & Pour Spout Design. As other people have stated in the reviews, the lids are frustrating to put on, where often you’re not even sure all sides are snapped closed fully, and the pour spout is very disappointing.

I am sorry I bought these, and should have listened to the negative comments.

product_metadata.title: Vremi Plastic Cereal Containers Storage Set with Lids - 2 Pack BPA Free 3L and 5 Liter Dry Food Container Set with Pour Spout and Airtight Silicone Seal Holds 12 or 21 Cups of Snacks Pasta or Pet Food
features: BIG FOOD KEEPER for KITCHEN and PANTRY - This 2pc cereal dispenser set comes with 3L (12 cups) and 5L (21 cups) containers with measuring labels. Holds large amounts of assorted snacks, cat and dog food, flour, rice, chips, or pasta, and each piece is tall enough to work as a spaghetti container

VACUUM SEAL LIDS and EASY POUR SPOUT - These food storage containers come with a 4-sided snap on leak proof lock and attached flip top lids that make sure what’s inside stays fresh. The round easy pour spout assists with portion control and is large enough for your cereal flakes to pass

CLEAR DISPENSER with MEASURING LABELS - Made of high quality, durable and clear non toxic plastic that lets you see what is stored inside and tells you whenever you are running out of cereal. With graduation marks for easy and accurate measuring so you get the exact serving size every time

MULTI USE and VERSATILE HOME ORGANIZER - These plastic containers are great for more than just food. You can store crafts, office supplies, toys for kids, baby products and more to fit variety of home storage and organization needs. Also great as an airtight coffee storage container for keeping large quantities of beans fresh

DISHWASHER SAFE with SPACE SAVING DESIGN - Reusable rectangular storage features a slim and easy-to-carry narrow body that requires less space when stored on shelves or countertop. With removable blue and green lids for a pop of color in your kitchen. Both bins and lids are freezer and dishwasher safe
description: Swipe right on storage because
Vremi Cereal Daters Containers

have moves that are proven to work, making sure that stale cereal won’t ruin your morning. Whether your type is crunchy granola or super sweet, these 2 tall, heavy duty clear plastic containers with graduation marks and colorful lids turn on the charm to make your cereal (and other dry foods) everything you’ve ever wanted. Great use not only as cereal or oatmeal keepers but also as a travel storage set for crafts, office supplies or toddler toys and as an all-around home organizer for baking goods and pet food for your cute cats and dogs. Double your storage with 3 liter and 5 liter capacity options to fit 12 or 21 cups of cereals with silicone seal on lids features a 4 sided locking system to keep contents 100% watertight and air tight.
